title: Identifying and Measuring Token-Level Sentiment Bias in Pre-trained Language Models with Prompts

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating token-level sentiment bias of neutral words using two prompt-based methods: Sentiment Association Test (SAT), which predicts a word's sentiment polarity based on its association with positive or negative reviews, and Sentiment Shift Test (SST), which measures the shift in a model's sentiment classification accuracy when a neutral word is repeatedly appended to reviews.
